headline: Unknown Truck Driver Cuts Debut Record at Memphis Studio
dispatch: Memphis, Tennessee, July 6, 1954. An 19-year-old named Elvis Presley walked out of Sun Records on Union Avenue yesterday with a lacquer disc containing a raw, propulsive rendition of Arthur Crudup's blues number. Producer Sam Phillips, who had been searching for a white singer with a Negro sound and feel, declared the take a keeper after midnight. The record is to be pressed as a single for regional release.
answer: Elvis Presley records his first single at Sun Records, 1954
